sections.text:
The protection relay for 
 Auxiliary generator GPU-2000R is a multifunction relay manufactured by ABB and 
 this relay is a digital type. differential & phase time over current & phase 
 instantaneous Voltage controlled time & Loss of excitation & over voltage & 
 volts / Hertz & distance / impedance & stator ground fault inadvertent 
 energize & phase unbalance / negative sequence & over frequency fault function 
 are utilized

The first draft initiated and tested by eng. Mohamed Amin at 13 March 2006, 
 accepted by eng. Dia Elgabalawy general manager, approvd by eng. Abdel 
 Kareem abou Zeid head sector of High Dam power station, certified by eng. 
 Kamel Raghd Hakem: HGPC quality control general manager & MPIS coordinator, eng. Mohamed 
 Faragalla: HGPC head sector of inspection and quality control.

The first update initiated 
and tested by eng. Tarik Abd Elmegeed,at 3 August 2009,accepted by general director eng. 
Sleem Ahmed Ali, and approved by eng .Abd Elnabi Abd Elghani Pre-Sector Head This document reviewed by 
HPGC eng. Abd Elhafez Farghaly, accepted by eng. Mohamed Usamal; HPGC inspection 
& quality control general director, MPIS coordinator

items: A work permit must be issued,

The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and carry the suitable 
 safety ID category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Block out of service is required
Make sure all block test switches are out
Ensure all CT path elements are secure after any test disturbance
Double F6150 test set
Laptop with ECP relay software downloaded
Voltmeter, test plug and test leads

Review the manual 
 and drawings.

Prepare the previous 
 or commissioning results of the relay testing.

Check the wires of 
 the relay by hand.

Check the AC source 
 is available to the tester

Check the existence 
 of the DC sources in panels

Insert the test plug 
 into current & voltage test switches and connect it to the tester according to 
 the drawing and scheme

Check all the leads 
 used in tests

Make the connections 
 as shown in figure 1, for the neutral phase A current transformer.

Set the timer to 
 start upon application of current and to stop when the contact monitor senses 
 a closed contact.

Apply the minimum 
 current (0.2)A.

The "pickup" LED on 
 the relay should light and the contact should indicate a closed contact.

The "Differential" 
 LED should also light.

The time for a 
 differential trip should be approximately two (2) cycles

Repeat the above 
 tests for the neutral phase B and the neutral phase C current transformers.

Test the load side 
 of the differential circuit,

Repeat the above 
 tests for the load phase A current transformer using the connections as shown 
 in figure 1

Repeat the tests 
 using the load phase B and the load phase C current transformer.

sections.text: Testing the 51 P phase time Over Current Function

items:
Make the connection 
 as shown in figure1, for the phase to be tested.

Apply a balance 
 voltage of 53 volts RMS phase to neutral.

Set a single phase 
 of current to 6 amperes RMS.

Set the timer to 
 start upon application of current and to stop when the contact monitor senses 
 a closed contact.

Apply the current to 
 the relay. The "pickup" LED should be lit and the unit should trip in 4.00 
 seconds 7% The "Over current / Impedance" LED should be lit

Repeat the test for 
 the remaining phases listed, as shown in figure1.

sections.text:
Testing the (50P phase instantaneous &51VC voltage 
controlled time) over Current Function

items:
Make the 
 connections as shown in figure1, for the phase to be tested.

Apply a balance 
 3-phase voltage of 40 phase voltage of volts RMS phase to neutral.

Set a single phase 
 of current to 6 amperes RMS.

Slowly increase the current and to stop when the contact monitor senses a 
 closed contact
The "pickup" LED should be lit and the "over current" LED should be flashing

sections.text: Testing the 40 loss of excitation function

items: Make the connections as shown in figure 1, for the phase to be tested

Apply a balance 3-phase voltage of 57 phase to neutral volts RMS and set a 
 3-phase of current to 3 ampere RMS with a phase angle of 90" leading

Slowly increase the current and to stop when the contact monitor senses a 
 closed contact

The "pickup" LED should be lit and the "loss of excitation" LED should be 
 flashing

sections.text:
Testing the 67P Phase Directional over current 
Function

items:
Make the 
 connections as shown in figure1, for the voltage phase to be tested.

Apply a balanced 
 3-phase voltage of 53 phase to neutral volts RMS and set a single phase of 
 current to 10 ampere RMS in phase with its voltage.

Set the timer to 
 start upon application of current and to stop when the contact monitor senses 
 a closed contact

Apply the current 
 to the relay.

The "pickup" 
 LED should be lit and the "Over current" LED should be flashing.

The unit should 
 trip in 1.93 seconds 7%. The "over current" LED should be it. Change the 
 angle of the tested phase current by 180.
Again apply the current to the relay.
Verify that the relay does not trip.

Repeat the test for the remaining phases listed, 
 as shown in figure1

Make the connections as shown in figure2, page 
 16, for the phase to be tested.

Apply a single-phase voltage of 57 volts RMS to 
 the relay

Slowly increase only the tested phase's voltage 
 from 76 volts RMS.

The "pickup" LED is lit. This should occur when 
 the voltage reaches 75 3% volts RMS. The relay should trip in 1 seconds later.

The contact 
 monitor should indicate a closed contact and the "voltage - volts / Hertz" LED 
 should be lit.

Repeat the above 
 test with a balanced 3-phase voltage

Examine the 
 Operation Records. All of the tests are indicated by a "59 trip" event
Make the connections as shown in figure 2, for the phase to be tested
Apply a balance voltage of 57 volts RMS phase to neutral

Slowly increase the voltage and to stop when the contact monitor senses a 
 closed contact

The "pickup" LED should be lit and the "voltage-volts/hertz" LED should be 
 flashing
Make the connections as shown in figure 1, for the phase to be tested
Apply a balance voltage of 10 volts RMS phase to neutral

Slowly increase the current and to stop when the contact monitor senses a 
 closed contact

The "pickup" LED should be lit and the "over current / impedance" LED should 
 be flashing

sections.text: Testing the 59G stator ground fault function

items: Make the connections as shown in figure 5, for the phase to be tested
Apply a balance voltage of 57 volts RMS phase to neutral
Apply a volts RMS at 50 hertz representing the V

Slowly increase the voltage V and to stop when the contact monitor 
 senses a closed contact
The "pickup" LED should be lit and the "stator ground" LED should be flashing

sections.text:
Testing the 27G stator ground 3rd 
harm under voltage fault function

items: Make the connections as shown in figure 5, for the phase to be tested
Apply a balance voltage of 57 volts RMS phase to neutral
Apply a volts RMS at 150 hertz representing the V
Set a volts Vo.to 4 volt

Slowly decrease the voltage Vo and to stop when the contact monitor senses a 
 closed contact
The "pickup" LED should be lit
Make the connections as shown in figure 1, for the phase to be tested
Apply a balance three- phase voltage of 57 volts RMS phase to neutral
Apply a balance three-phase current of 3 amperes RMs at 50 HZ

Change the frequency setting to 46 Hz to the voltage and to stop when the 
 contact monitor senses a closed contact

The "pickup" LED should be lit and the "reverse power" and the "over current / 
 impedance" LED should be flashing

sections.text:
Testing the 46 phase unbalance / negative sequence 
function

items: Make the connections as shown in figure 2, for the phase to be tested
Apply a balance three - phase voltage of 57 volts RMS phase to neutral
Set a single - phase current to 0.4 amperes RMS

Slowly increase the current and to stop when the contact monitor senses a 
 closed contact

The "pickup" LED should be lit and the "phase unbalance" LED should be 
 flashing
Make the connections as shown in figure 2, for the phase to be tested

Apply a balance three - phase voltage of 57 volts RMS phase to neutral at 
 frequency of 50.0Hz

Slowly increase the frequency and to stop when the contact monitor senses a 
 closed contact
The "pickup" LED should be lit and the "frequency" LED should be flashing

Return relay to 
 service by removing the test plugs, and switch on test switches.

Check relay 
 configuration and logic.
